acceptanceCriteria.text: Exit code (and spawn/timeout) is checked and used as the primary failure classification before any stdout JSON parsing/shape validation is attempted.
On a nonzero exit, bounded stdout/stderr diagnostics are still retained on the resulting error/result object (not lost).
New tests cover the matrix: nonzero exit + malformed stdout → command-failed; signal termination + partial stdout → command-failed; zero exit + malformed stdout → contract-invalid (unchanged).

issue.title: fix: classify Nawabari nonzero exit before parsing its response envelope
